fields.label: Statement
fields.value: A homogeneous steady state of two reacting chemicals that is stable without diffusion can become unstable to spatial perturbations when the chemicals diffuse at different rates, spontaneously producing a pattern.

fields.value: Measure the reaction Jacobian and the diffusivities of a candidate morphogen pair independently, check that the inequality holds, and then confirm that perturbing the diffusivity ratio switches patterning on or off.
